source.title: Open problems in the degree theory for disc minimal surfaces spanning a curve in ℝ3

trace.notes: Normalized the single input URL as a zbMATH document locator. Direct shell fetch of https://zbmath.org/4115574 returned a Cloudflare 403 challenge, so the zbMATH API was used as an identifier-specific resolver and returned document id 4115574, DOI 10.1007/BFb0082876, year 1988, and the exact title.

Resolved DOI 10.1007/BFb0082876 to the Springer chapter page. The page confirmed the same title, author A. J. Tromba, pages 379-401, and parent volume, but it marked the chapter as no-access/subscription preview and did not expose readable full text containing the problem statements.

Attempted the Springer citation PDF URL https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/BFb0082876.pdf. The download completed but the artifact was an HTML access page rather than a PDF, so it was classified as missing_or_invalid_artifact.

Ran bounded exact-work recovery searches using the DOI/BFb identifier, the exact title plus PDF, and the exact title plus Tromba. Inspected candidates included Springer, ScienceGate, Hoepli, Cebookss, Kriso, Books-Express, and Barnes & Noble pages. These were paywalled, metadata-only, table-of-contents listings, or book-commerce pages. Scribd and ResearchGate candidates were different books and were rejected as not the same exact work.

trace.notes: No candidates were accepted because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered. The source adequacy gate forbids extraction from zbMATH metadata, Springer preview metadata, abstracts, table-of-contents pages, or search snippets.
Saved exact JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-4115574.json and outputs/latest.json.
